fetch top selling item from november 2025 to january 2026

```sql
SELECT `sii`.`item_code`, 
       SUM(`sii`.`qty`) AS `total_quantity_sold`
FROM `tabSales Invoice` AS `si`
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` AS `sii` ON `si`.`name` = `sii`.`parent`
WHERE `si`.`posting_date` >= '2025-11-01' 
  AND `si`.`posting_date` <= '2026-01-31'
GROUP BY `sii`.`item_code`
ORDER BY `total_quantity_sold` DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

generate a report of leads that were converted to sales order in last 3 months

```sql
SELECT `l`.`name` AS `lead_name`, 
       `l`.`lead_name` AS `lead_full_name`, 
       `l`.`company_name`, 
       `l`.`email_id`, 
       `l`.`mobile_no`, 
       `so`.`name` AS `sales_order_name`, 
       `so`.`transaction_date` AS `sales_order_date`
FROM `tabLead` AS `l`
JOIN `tabSales Order` AS `so` ON `l`.`name` = `so`.`lead`
WHERE `so`.`transaction_date` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY `l`.`name`, `so`.`name`
ORDER BY `so`.`transaction_date` DESC
LIMIT 100;
```
